text: I was super excited to try this place since I am Gluten free and havent had donuts in years!  First let me start by saying the service was absolutely wonderful. The fact that they are even open during these times,  take orders and payments by phone,  even willing to bring our order out to the car when we arrived was a huge plus. We tried the mudslide, chocolate overload,  chocolate raspberry,  and cookies and creme flavors. All of the flavors were great,  and I absolutely loved the texture. Honestly to me they were more of a moist,  dense cake then your typical donut consistancy but it was a nice surprise and would have been really decadent if it weren't for the horrible chemichal-like after taste of sweetner alternative. It was so bad and so dissapointing we could not have more than a couple of small bites of any of the flavors we bought. I truly am hoping this review is seen and used as constructive criticism because overall we really loved the idea and would absolutely be willing to try it out again if they began offering options with other  sugar alternatives. There are many like honey,  pure maple syrup,  date syrup,  agave,  coconut sugar,  the list goes on,  that do not have the awful after taste that ruined an otherwise great donut.

We went to Elliston Place (Franklin) on a Saturday evening at 6:45 - party of 7. First thing that struck us was there was almost nobody there. The weather was less than ideal - heavy rain. But still surprised at lack of crowd - most restaurants in the area are always packed. Next, the service was surprisingly slow. Why?  With only a few other tables, we expected quite the opposite. Third, this was our first visit, and there was a big sign next to the check in counter showing meat and 3 options.  But the server informed us that is only for weekdays. So why not simply remove the sign? (It would have been easy to set aside.)  Also...the website shows fried chicken on Saturday's for meat and three. As for food, it was a mixed bag. Overall food quality was decent. But I ordered the Reubilly sandwich - a Reuben with coleslaw instead of sauerkraut. My sandwich came with both. I'm not averse to kraut, but it didn't mix all that well with coleslaw. And given our service was slow, I didn't want to ask for them to make another. They also forgot to make my daughter's hot dog, so we had to wait for that. 

Bottom line is that while it wasn't a terrible experience, it also wasn't great. Too bad, because it seems like a great concept, and we've heard good things about the Nashville location. There are so many options for restaurants in this area that I'm not sure why I would give this on another chance. Except that I really want to try the shakes...so we might give it another shot on a week

Decided to go here for Sunday brunch around 10 AM and they were already bustling and sold out of fried chicken! Got a waffle with fried fish instead which was definitely a nice light combination for an early meal and didn't feel too sweet or too savory but had a good balance - especially surprised at how well the fish went with the waffle. If anything I would like to see more options for sides with the waffle entree as I didn't feel it was completely satisfying enough to call it brunch - just breakfast. Maybe a sausage or biscuit on the side just round things up? 

 My partner got the beef tongue sandwich which he didn't love but only because the meat was too fibrous for his taste. Coffee was from Tinker and refillable which is a plus! I also noticed they have some interesting community events like worst movie Wednesday's etc. that sound intriguing! The decor is eclectic and the service is prompt even with the crowd. The menu can be confusing and intimidating but worth a second visit!
I dream about their wings, kimchi fried rice, and koagies! I love this place so much! I can't wait to order again soon!
Great fresh salads and bowls. Healthy food and portions and the curbside pickup was the best.

You've FOUND IT! If you're looking for GOOD FOOD, with that extra touch of NOLA flair, with a GOOD dash of customer service, you've found your spot! I've had the Beaucoup Blend wings, lemon pepper wings, jerk fish sandwich (if ur not into lots of mayo, be sure to say "lite",) classic burger, seasoned fries, and grilled veggies.  ALL were REALLY GOOD, especially the Beaucoup Blend wings & jerk fish.  Lots of flavor, and just the right texture of crisp! As for customer service, we had an order that wasnt right, and Ellen Rose, the manager, could NOT have been more apologetic, helpful & eager to make it right! Another EXCELLENT FACT: this place is LOCALLY, MINORITY OWNED, and they deliver thru Door Dash! FORGET WING STOP! At BEAUCOUP EATS, you get GREAT wings, and MUCH MORE!

I love this restaurant! The ambiance, noise level, food and service are all fabulous! I had the sausage flat bread last time and it was delish! The Cosmo was perfect, too! Our server was so nice and diligent! We will be back many more times to try everything on the menu! My husband had the summer pasta and raved about it and how fresh the veggies were! Highly recommend!
Best blackened grouper sandwich on the beach (and I lived in the area for almost 8 years).  Eclectic atmosphere and not fancy, just good food at PJs.  A place where the locals eat!
Always excellent, healthy  food and nice people.  Optimus Prime, Butternut squash burrito.. and yummy breakfast choices.   Desserts are amazing.

When we entered the reception was cold and we were told the manager would need to first speak with us. After several minutes we asked why the manager needed to us, we were told it was because we were a party of 6. When the manager finally came out she said it would be 30 minutes to seat us. We declined and as we were leaving she miraculously fingered out how to accommodate our party. No thanks, the cold reception was enough to make our minds up to go elsewhere.

Ok. Finally found this spot and so happy I took the time to stop. I got a medium ice and a funnel cake - and it was a great value. The medium ice was a lot for the price and the funnel cake was huge.

The ice.... It is not quite like a snowball. It was fine and soft and dense, so you get more ice than you would in a snowball. And because the flavor is in the ice, you don't have to worry about not having enough syrup like you do at some snowball stands. When I told the gentleman that  waited on me. That it was my first time, he gave me samples of several flavors. Each and every one was great. I will definitely be back. Often.

When you walk up it looks great. Food looks fresh.  It's clean. 

Then the staff. The employees could care less. Bad attitudes like you are doing them a favor by eating there. 

I ordered a toasted everything bagel with cream cheese.  The coffee was hot.  But old and bitter. The bagel was warmed slightly and had a bad of freshness on it. 

Next time you have a craving for a bagel, get it someplace else.

The workers at this Peets were so friendly! I was surprised at how kind they were, especially right after coming from SFO. I got there around 1:30 pm on a Thursday afternoon and there was no line. I went in and was greeted by two super sweet employees who took my order right away. The drink was made so fast! It's a little pricey since it's in an airport, but the service made it worth it. Thank you!
Delicious Spanish tapas! 100% coming back here next time I'm in SB. Highly recommend the jamon tasting plater, the chorizo & chicken paella, and the churros.

Always friendly, even when busy; I think it's funny that every time I get a pizza they automatically ask if I know how to bake the pizza.  But, the pizza is always ready when I order ahead

Update for this pandemic period: They Are busy, but my last order was Not ready and I gave them 15 minutes more than my order.  They seemed not as friendly.  I will give them another chance, though, because their pizza is still good.

Excellent food! What I've always wanted - high quality takeout and a place that cuts the fuss out of having a "dining experience". There is already plenty of that on the New Orleans scene (which takes itself a little too seriously and is often a huge expense and hassle). Apparently the chef here was trained in some of the top restaurants here, and it shows. Yum!

This restaurant is a huge disappointment as they are using canned sauces and veggies. Our experience a week ago was very shameful. I wanted to try a new Thai place and with the outstanding reviews, I thought it would be a new favorite. We threw away most of the food (Basil sauce pork, clear noodles w/chicken, Pad Kee Mao and green curry) which was a $65 order. All garbage except the white steam rice. If you are looking for real Thai food or edible food that will not make you feel disgusted, please keep looking. I just do not believe that many of the reviews here can be true. But, they worked in getting me to try it out.

Nice place, friendly staff. the chicken salad was a bit expensive for the portion, but it was pretty good. Ordered a deep dish to go, did not care for the sauce or the cheese pull. Next time I'll try to order their thin crust and see how it is before I give up on them :)

This is the absolute worst casino restaurant I've ever been to in all of Nevada and I've eaten at most of them. Paying the most for the worst quality of food. Our server was really nice but that was the only good part about this place. Everything we ate was not only in incredibly small portions, but it also tasted like something out of the freezer aisle of Walmart.

This place is one of my favorite foodie spots! I've been here numerous times and this place is still one of favorite places to go while in Philly!  The variety of shops and food options are so vast that you could spend hours there. Shops ranging from homemade goods, souvenirs, candy, bakeries, donuts, cookies, fresh vegetable and fruits, cheeses, meats...I could go on forever. And also a variety of food places so everyone's tastes buds will be fulfilled even the pickiest of eaters. The only unfortunate thing is that a lot of the Amish owned shops aren't open on Sundays. So a lot of those sections are blocked off since they are closed. We had gotten there a little later in the day so the cookie shop had a sale on their cookies for $1 each! It was def a steal. Also stopped by Termini Bros. and got some freshly filled cannolis! 

Reading Terminal is def a great stop if you're going to Philly! Though we didn't get to eat there--there is a seated food court section for everyone to enjoy your meal. This place is also perfect one stop grocery shopping!

Went here with my wife for a birthday surprise and this was an experience. We came on their special Italian night and it was great! It was a five course meal, portions small, but delicious. We enjoyed most of the courses, the bolognese was a bit "meaty" (seiten) for our taste. Overall the experience is something to be tried, the food was great. If I could change one thing, I'd add another server. The service, which was great, may not be fit for just one person dealing with a communal table of 12 and then about 8 others. It is BYOB, so you are waiting for your drink to be poured, and then water cups then tend to run out quickly. Should be tried for sure by all vegetarians though.
I had a delicious take out meal from South Philly Italian restaurant! Highly recommend. I did delievery and they were prompt and responsive.
Omfg. Payton was the best waitress. So nice & helpful. Pls come & visit her. She gave me lots of potatoes :) & I LOVE potatoes...

Pre Pandemic we would visit Charro steak for dinning several times a year and even prior to seeing stage productions at Arizona Theatre Company.   Since the pandemic we have not felt safe with indoor dining, even with all the precautions they are taking,  but we want to support one of our favorite restaurants, so we have ordered ahead their holiday family kits and grill kits.  Everything is prepared to perfection and we just needed to follow the instructions to reheat or grill.    Cuts of meat were spectacular, just like we got when dining in person. Today we just finished our Christmas meal from Charro steak.   It was fantastic and so much flavor. My small family raved  over it and the cook was happy not to spend time preparing the meal, since charro steak took care of it.  We hope to be in person in the future, but we will continue to order grill kits and to go. 

Support local during this time and tip like you are dining in,
Birthday dinner. Only second time out as things have opened up since COVID 19. Great service and food.

Incredible brilliant balance of flavors and dessert magnificent. Delicious seasonal dishes. A pleasant serendipitous surprise how we got to have dinner at The Black Sheep when my sister and I visited SB. We will go back! Thank you chef and service excellent

The best chicken shawarma sandwich EVER ( get extra garlic sauce ) but the bakery is what makes this place soooo amazing! I've never had anything that wasn't insanely delicious and the market has so much you never knew you needed. These small grocery businesses deserve your support.

Adore Harp. I shot an event here last year, and have been back many times. The ambiance is perfect. Perfect for a date, perfect for friends. Let's not forget the bowling alley downstairs. So cute!! 

Their happy hour is one of Philly's best kept secrets, as well as their brunch. 

The hh for sure, you can't beat. 

Buffet brunch with basically everything imaginable, great to bring friends or family visiting from out of town! 


Love it here. 




@hailey_photography

This review is not based on the food because we left before being seated due to the unmotivated and unprofessional team who was working today as hostess, and those behind the counter. Either the organizational culture at the venue is always a drag, or the downpour of rain REALLY brought it out of them. I'm going with the latter. Clearly irritated evidenced by zero smiles, zero hospitality, zero initiative to assist with seating our party of 4 for brunch, (the hostess kept saying she needed to get a count and a recount of the available tables), one employee kept complaining about her 1-3 hour drive back home in the rain, all the while we waited at their cramped entrance, soaking wet from our walk from the parking lot in the steady stream of rain, which took some decent treasure hunting skills (even with GPS) because of their inconvenient location. There are a ton of other restaurants (Cajun Kitchen is one) with better trained staff, efficient, and friendly service, seamless parking lot, and decent food. Scarlette Begonia is NOT the place to go for anything resembling world-class service ~
Definitely go back on my next visit to Clearwater. Chicken parm w/spaghetti and vodka sauce .

Be warned, if you order a drink "on the rocks", you will be charged $2.00 for "ice". OUTRAGEOUS !!  Will never go here again.  The food was good, but we were rushed out by the wait staff, and when the bill arrived, there was a $2.00 charge for "ice". When we questioned the charge, we were told by the owner that it was actually for an "extra pour".  Never in my life have I been charged extra for ice. We were not told, or asked if we wanted an extra pour.  If the owner was a mensch, he would have apologized that we were not informed of the extra charge and taken it off the bill. But he left it on there!!!  OUTRAGEOUS!!  At least we have a story to share with friends and laugh about for the rest of our lives.
The meal was amazing! Jen was the server and she was an outstanding server. She went above and beyond. I truly appreciate her amazing customer service. Keep up the good work!!!

Went to see the Lion King, great movie, the animation had me questioning if it was real life or not!

Onto Irish 31. On our way out of the movie we saw a sign outside that said "1/2 appetizers with movie stub" so we decided to stop in. 

We ordered a few different appetizers. Boneless wings, both BBQ and Garlic Parm. The BBQ were okay, but being the big garlic guy that I am, the Garlic Parm Wings were phenomenal. I think I licked the plate after the wings were gone. The pickle chips were bomb. 

We've been looking for a good boxty since moving to Tampa, and although not your traditional boxty, Irish 31's deep fried mashed potato version is pretty good! Nice and crispy on the outside, with all your fixins on the inside. 

Just a tip, only 1 app is half price per check if you have a movie stub! The bartender was kind enough to split the checks for us. 

7.1/10 - Will be back for my Garlic Parm wings

Open for pick up and delivery, but call ahead to verify order options during quarantine. 

We ordered a large lasagna pizza and a side of meatballs. The pizza was amazing and loaded with flavor and tons of toppings. The lasagna pizza has Italian sausage, ricotta, basil and garlic drizzled with EVOO (extra virgin olive oil)... omg! This pizza was delicious and hard not to keep eating even though I was beyond full. The meatballs were tasty too, but were a little too oily for me. My wife loved them and finished off. 

I can't wait until this place officially opens up, so I can sit at the bar, sip a beer and nosh on some pizza in house!

I came here when I was craving some cheese fries on a Sunday night. I placed an order online for the loaded fries and the bacon ranch fries. Parking was a bit of an issue, but I found a small parking lot with some open spots on the river side. The food was ready to go when I got there and thankfully stayed warm on the drive home. Both orders of fries were large and had tons and tons of cheese. The loaded fries come topped with BBQ covered pulled pork that had really nice flavor. I thought that it could have used a bit more of the pulled pork and maybe some more sour cream as well. The bacon ranch fries came with two cups of ranch to pour or dip as you please. Even though the fries were very good, my wife and I weren't able to finish either order due to them being so large. My craving for cheese fries was definitely satisfied, and I will likely return to Cooter Brown's if I'm wanting any again in the future.
Met sone friends here....good food & excellent service....i will be back!!!!!I really like the set up.
This place just totally worked for last weekend. It really helped to impress my date. The food was good the atmosphere and vibe was my favorite thing. Along with top notch service.
We got "the bomb" burger and pizza and it was some of the best food ever. Highly recommend if you're in the area to eat here!! Will definitely be coming back.
This Alexandria and yes I did work there with you for a week or so. I just did not like how I was treated that day over the phone . And I know Najma was on vacation until July

I usually enjoy ordering from here but I noticed they mentioned a new recipe for the chipotle avocado chicken sandwich. It tastes bland now and the broccoli cheddar soup was watery and bland as well. Incredibly disappointed and probably won't be coming back.

We had lunch at Char on Friday, July 17th.  I had the lunch special, fried catfish with mashed potatoes and creamed spinach.  It was excellent.  Our meal was freshly served by an experienced server.  I could not have asked for a better meal.  I have been to Char in Green Hills several times and have always been pleased.  But this was over the top good.  I'll be back!

Overall, a great spot! Service can be a little inconsistent, but overall is good. Ordering for pickup has always been a great option as well. Great menu with classic and specialty rolls as well as other appetizers and entrees. The owner Pui is fabulous as well and very involved in the local community.

I took my car here for an inspection and I was told it wouldn't pass without new brakes. Took it to another auto body shop and they told me I didn't even need new brakes yet and they couldn't believe that I was told I needed new ones. Really annoyed about this and feel like they just were trying to make some more money off of me. I wouldn't recommend this place!

I have been to their 3 other locations, but had yet to try the Sparks legends location. My fiancé and I were greeted by Giovanni and was seated in a booth on the right hand side of the restaurant. We had time to look at the menu which is full of options for every taste. Sandwiches, soups, wraps, burgers, small bites. They have it all! 

I ordered a 16 oz chai tea and my fiancé ordered a mandarin key lime soda, to start off. Both were delicious and started off the experience on a high note. We then placed our order for dinner. Giovanni and our server (I don't remember him introducing himself) checked on us periodically and made sure we were liking our drinks and food once it was served. 

The vibe from the music playing, the artwork from local artists and the upbeat staff made for an overall very pleasant experience.

Our food was absolutely delicious. My fiancé likes spicy food and said it was the right amount of spice, the burger was made a perfect medium well and was juicy and seasoned well, too. I always order the gourmet grilled cheese and here is why. The creamy pesto aioli, the flavors of the cheddar, Havarti, provolone, and mozzarella melted together together makes for a silky smooth bite with the juicy tomato, the salty addition the bacon adds and the crunch from the truckee sour dough bread makes for the greatest sandwich ever. It's like fireworks in my mouth. Just so many amazing flavors at once. Dip it in the tomato soup and you have your childhood happiness that i

I got the veggie burger and it was perfectly adequate! A little spicy. Dry. Somehow managed to be both a little bland and spicy but overall not bad! I finished almost all of it which is saying something for me because burgers aren't my favorite. But the service was really great, super fast and helpful. All in all not bad. But a bit pricey for what it is.

This is the best Viet spot in NE Philly/Bensalem. Been going here since they first opened. Excellent food. The pho is consistent and the sliced grilled pork w/ broken rice is my favorite item here. It's worth a try. The only issue is the parking since it gets busy on weekends.

I ordered online with 45 minutes ahead. I got 4 souffles 3 of them were spinach and artichoke and the other one was  a bacon one. I paid over $20 to find out they were burned. You go to Panera's for a decent meal. Very disappointed.
Loved this little place. The only thing was their "sourdough" bread didn't seem like it at all and just seemed like white bread.

The other Beignet spot... with a little less fanfare and shorter lines but equally good. Didn't want to stand in the  cold rainy weather on the gloomy Sunday morning at the other beignet spot, so we opted for Cafe Beignet, and they didn't disappoint. Fresh hot and soft beignet's  out the fryer, what could be better in this weather. I only wish the coffee was a tad bit hotter. I like my joe pipping hot. Otherwise a perfect way to start the day in New Orleans.

Don't waste your time! ..... Reserved a table for the Cowboys/Saints game on the balcony.  The atmosphere was great but that is about it.  We were told when we got there at 6 pm that the kitchen wouldn't be open until 7.  Ordered our food at 7:20 and finally got a portion of what we ordered at 9:15 pm. We spoke with the manager and honestly, he was more concerned with his drink than managing the place. Our waiter, Tyler, did all he could do under the circumstances and was great.

I was craving a gyro and was down the street. I Live around the corner and always pass this place up so today I decided to stop in for a quick take out lunch and I'm glad I did. For a fast food chain the food was pretty good. I ordered the traditional gyro. The pita was very soft and fresh with great flavor, the Tatziki was also very good and fresh. The lettuce to Lamb ratio was good as some people put a lot more filler than meat. I did think the $8 price point was slightly high but the quality was worth it. Looking forward to trying the Greek salad next time. What's nice about the salad is you choose what's in it so you can get a traditional Greek salad and not the Florida version with potato salad, which lets face it is just weird. I think even Florida Man would agree

First time here.  Sweet tea: Not sweet and no sweetener in restaurant ( even after asking for some) to make it to my liking. 
Waited on quickly, but took a bit for food to come out. Here on Sunday afternoon, not  crowded.  
I had wings, they were good.  Would probably return to try the fried rice. 
I guess seafood boils are their specialty and unfortunately I am not a big seafood eater.
Great burger and fry place.  Wil go back for sure. Had the regular cheese burger. Great
The Chicken María is delicious! Get it with the white pasta side dish and you won't be disappointed. I probably would have rated better but was disappointed with the Chardonnay selection

Tacos El Rey 2 is a solid choice if you're looking for some authentic Mexican food. The have a great selection of tacos to choose from. They have plenty more to choose from as well. The tortas and flautas looked especially tasty as they were coming out. The hot sauce in the red container is definitely not for the faint of heart! This stuff will make you sweat!

Lindo Mexico has been my south side hole-in-the-wall go to for years. Last week I took my mom for lunch, and was happy to return. The service is fast and food is reliably good. Plus there's always a good cheap lunch special (like my Arroz con Pollo, which was $2 off through February). 

Covid precautions were good but staff tended to take off mask when off. Unfortunately, they did so and hung out right behind out table. Otherwise they'd get 5 stars.

Since my favorite bagel shop (The Bagel Factory on Independence Square) is closed, I had to find a new one.  And my criteria is a loaded Everything.  And Spread hits it out of the park.  Whether it's just toasted or with egg and meat, I sure am happy the baker is heavy-handed on sprinkling those bagels with everything.
You can't go wrong fish burritos! A top Mexican spot in Santa Barbara. Worth a drive if you're on lower state.

We did the catering platter menu for our small, intimate, pandemic wedding. My experience was as follows:
The first phone call I got a very confused employee who struggled to answer questions as basic as, "does the chicken Parmesan platter include pasta, or just chicken?" After getting many "I don't know" answers from him I was transferred to someone a lot more knowledgeable. I ordered salad, garlic bread, two entree dishes all in half platter servings. The next week I called to change the time of the delivery. I got another confused sounding employee that struggled to even find our order. After finding it, I confirmed they had my information again as I wasn't very confident in their organization at this point. 
The day of the delivery, I was so impressed by the professionalism of the delivery driver. He was wearing gloves, a mask, and laid everything out for us on a table. He was Hispanic and spoke to my family in Spanish which is always nice! He even offered to open all the containers for us. Included in the order were an excess of serving utensils, and eating utensils. I was so content with that part of the experience. The food itself was great! The diablo sauce was one of my favorite! Overall great experience, just a few rocky parts that made me nervous about my order being lost.

If I could give no stars I would. I ordered Easter Meal for my daughter who just moved to Philly. Big mistake not checking reviews 1st. I will not make that mistake again. I ordered baked mac&cheese and Blueberry Muffin that were omitted from the order, but they still charged me. Disgusting feathers were still on the chicken wings, so that went straight to the garbage. Salad arrived without Ranch dressing, so that went in the garbage. Waffles were too mushy, so that went in the garbage. Chocolate cake was not homemade & tasted like preservatives, so that went in the garbage. There was nothing worth eating. I wasted my money & upset my daughter who was expecting a very nice meal. With all the bad reviews, I don't know how they can still be in business. They need to be shut down & not waste people's hard-earned money. If feathers were still left on the chicken wings & no one caught it, I wonder how clean the restaurant is behind closed doors. Delivery guy called the wrong phone number when he got to the apartments. Thankfully, I answered his phone call which said call was from Killen, AL. Delivery guy spoke very poor English & could not understand he needed to call my daughter's cell so she could open the door for him since she is in Philly & I am in Texas which I stated on the order instructions. Does this look like a $36 meal?

Not your usual Mexican or Tex-Mex restaurant.  Gramma's recipes crafted by Mom and sister in the kitchen while two brothers handle the front.  Cuisine is Puebla from Central Mexico.  We three sisters shared two mains for lunch - mixiote, a marinated pork with a side of Mexican spaghetti and a chicken in green sauce.  Both were well seasoned with a hint of heat. The waiter suggested asking about the spiciness as it varies.

We went late to lunch and the crowd was slim.  We enjoyed the subtlety of the salsa, something even kids could enjoy

Looking for something new and tasty?  Try this  near Outback

Atmosphere was below average. Not all it's cracked up to be. Had the lobster rolls and the brisket Mac... lobster was good Mac was nasty... did not have a good selection of wine or beer. Not a bar that I would go back to or recommend.

The best beignets on this side of heaven!!!!! The food is AMAZING as well. We will definitely be back time and time again!

This is definitely and diamond in the rough. GREAT prices!!!!!!  Not far from Dooky Chase. Definitely put this one on your New Orleans list!!!!!!

So freaking good!! Drunken noodles are amazing. This hidden gem is a must try again and again. 
My husband likes the Thai Tulip Dumplings as well.
Muy rico pero los precioss son altos!! Es para hacer algo diferente así que vale la pena

The new swamp room opened last night. The place is nice with a modern touch. I do have to say the service was not the best. Not sure if they just have a new staff or cook. Now the swamp room has been in business for over 20 years so cooking and getting orders should be nothing new to them.   
I hate to say this as I like swamp room for the wed and sat special, steak night. The steak special was not as good as the old place. It was chewy last night. Usually the steaks are tender. 

Also to get a table was like being on the prowl for golden egg. You had to rush to the table first if someone gets up. Sometimes people walk in and across the room people get up and the new people get to the table first, all after you waited for 20 min. I really think they should use a numbering system. 

It took over an hour to get food, this is unacceptable to this place. I hope it will improve.
Horrible owners. They think it's ok to not pay their employees. In a time of crisis, the true colors of people have been exposed. Avoid this dump.

One of the best breakfasts I've had! The froze was delicious and not too sweet, the breakfast tacos were perfect, the portion was large, we could have split them. They have a good kids menu too and great coffee. The atmosphere is cool and the service great!

5 stars for food and attentiveness to diners. For an "order at the counter" kind of place, we were impressed that someone came around to every table checking on the guests. Some of the food was new to us, so we tried a couple of those. Starting with steamed gyoza, we were very happy. (Why is it so hard to get these steamed at other places? Most like to fry.) These were perfectly cooked and delicious. And the sauce that came with them was amazing. I ordered the Taiwan Beef, which was hugely proportioned. Filled with noodles, beef and bok choy, and the broth was delicious. My wife had the Dandan. She said it was delicious. The bowl was filled with noodles and pork.  The peanuts and a touch of cilantro made it perfect. we are looking forward to going back again and trying something different.
Love the pizza and wings from here. Order it at least once a week. Better pizza and a better price than the other local chains.
I have celiac and have to eat gluten free.  They have a great gluten free menu.  They are very aware of the allergy and have always given me safe food.  Good food, good options.

Slow, slow, slow food prep.  Over ten minutes for two biscuits and home fries...only two other customers present.
Food was so so, especially home fries which were not crisp at all.  Chicken was nothing special though touted as fresh, cooked to order, etc.

The food was pretty good, but the service is not good at all. We sat down and it took them 20 mins to notice us, then we waited an hour and a half for a meal we gobbled up in 5 mins. The only reason we even gave them a star was because of the food, but the service deserves no stars!

Have you tried this local gem??

Well it's a must!!! 

I gave 4 stars instead of 5 only because I was told an estimated wait time and it was triple that (they weren't busy and I went early!) I also paid extra for extra salmon and I was given the standard portion :(. The chef wasn't present today. The staff that I saw weren't wearing masks and were just a tad bit les then friendly. 

So aside from that, the food is amazing!!

I've been here a few times (pre-yelper), but this is my first review. 

I had the grilled trap panini and trap chowder. This was the delay for my order. They make them to order (awesome) but it took like 30 mins for a fancy grilled cheese. Anywho, it was delicious! It's so flavorful. The bread taste like OG trap buttah ...the insides overflow with gooey cheese and trap goodness...just delicious! The trap chowder is so freaking good! Like gimmie a gallon and a straw and I'm good for awhile. The chowder is filled with crab, shrimp, corn, potatoes and I'm guess Chef Oya "put her foot in it"...lol. It's my favorite item on the menu. There aren't words to describe its gimmie as...just be sure to get it when you visit. 

I ordered the salmon tray for a friend. I've had this before and it's good. I love the veggies and OG garlic buttah sauce w/ parm and spicy seasoning is the way to go! Other sauces are offered but I love this one so mention I'm scared to try a new one!

Food was good but definitely not good enough to warrant their prices. I think this place works better as a bar with good food rather than a restaurant that also happens to have a bar. Wait staff were great and the place was spotless.

Ordered delivery . Positives. Chicken fingers were good , as well as the mozzarella sticks.
The pizza however, just wasn't good at all imo. It seriously felt like a frozen pizza you'd get at the store.  I understand that the sauce is sweeter than most, I could get over that, if it was actually good. The cheese legit seemed right off of an Elios and the bread was just not up to any other pizzerias quality.  I am actually not sure if I can think of a pizza I just like more than this in my entire life and I mean that with all honesty and nothing personal against this pizza place that I don't even live by. It was just very disappointing and people need to know
good spot. I liked the enchiladas I got. very chill and laid-back dining experience.

Extremely disappointed.  Traveling from out of town and went with friends.  Server was very good and knew what she was doing.  Ordered the $48 Ribeye special.  Got a 1/2 inch thick steak that looked like it came from the Kroger meat case.  Over cooked and tough.  Was expecting more of a high end steak based on price but shocked at what came out.  Prices match moderately priced steak houses yet atmosphere is an Indy bar.  Steer clear for sure.

Came by on a Friday night. Very young vibes with music and affordable food. Got the fried chicken and it was great! Service was super friendly and quick. Waitress had the same birthday as me which was crazy! Nice place to dine with friends!

Before ordering and before going to pickup OR have your food delivered, go into this knowing you will wait an insanely long time for your food. 

That being said, this place was dope and the food was delicious. You get a large amount of food for a decent price as well. Totally recommend giving it a go. 

Expect to wait an hour. Or more.

Love the Hawke!!! Family owned and run...which is why the food is always awesome!!!  Everything is good but I especially love the salmon salad...the dressing is so light and refreshing. 
Great pub setting and patio too! The historical building really does make you feel like you've stepped back in time which has made it one of my favorite spots to have Revolutionary events.

My friend got me one of my favorite things they're chocolate cheese danish for my birthday. What a great surprise and it is truly fabulous as always. When I got back from Denmark around 20 years ago I found Darryls through a friend and realize they are the only bakery in the area that can bake fantastic danish just like the Dean's in Denmark.
Really good! And it's super cute  in there. Reasonable prices. Definitely eating here again

If you're looking for delicious lamb gyro wrap and you happen to be in the Roxborough area then you're in luck! They have great quality and they're not shy with the meat serving, good prices, good customer service and to top it off and nice clean restaurant! Ive received good vibes everytime I walk in so that besides the food being good makes me feel good about supporting this business. I suggest getting the lamb gyro with light onions and tomatoes, spicy tzatziki sauce and add lettuce. Delcious!!

Solo has got to be my favorite go to skewer bar in Chinatown. Anytime I'm hungry or just craving something savory but I don't want to eat too much, I always stop here to pick up some skewers. 
This place is like a hidden gem. It's a little hard to find the door on the street, but it's right across from the Chinatown Arch. 
This place is open until 2 am, which is probably my favorite thing about it because it's great drunk food. Not only that, the skewer are cheap too! I prefer these skewers over Yakitori boys. 
If you are ever in Chinatown, put this on your list of places to try. It may not look like much from the view of the place but the skewers are great.

Took my mom here today as part of Mother's Day Celebration and my boyfriend as part of a graduation celebration. The service was amazing, the staff was very attentive and nice. The food was delicious and full of flavor. The location is really cute.

Stopped in for breakfast on 3/27 around 10 AM. The crowd was light and we had undivided service from start to finish. I ordered the college skillet with a pancake, which came out plentiful and warm. My friend ordered 2 eggs, 2 meats and biscuits and gravy. He commented that the biscuits and gravy were exceptionally fresh. Both of us commented on the tasty coffee after several refills. We were shocked to find out it was Ronnoco. Whoever is making it is doing it right. Keep up the good work and service as always. When dining out in Alton, Frank's continues to be the first choice on the list. You just can't beat the food, the prices or the service.

Very busy around lunch .. got in right away very good.food as fast friendly staff an service 
I had the chicken liver very good. But way to.much for me too eat
Boiled crawfish and crabs were beyond delicious!!! Hot and spicy!! Don't wait, when it's gone, it's gone!
Great food for the price! Quick and efficient. Very good sushi and chinese but their sweet and sour chicken is okay.

Service was cheerful and prompt.
It's your basic diner/coffee shop menu. It has lots of breakfast items, and you can get breakfast all day. Nothing gourmet or innovative here, but if you want breakfast, this is a good choice.

I liked this place - I always love creative menus.
Theirs is asian with a southern flair.
The food was good, but not worth the price for the portion.
If it's a small portion I need great & it just missed the mark - maybe too experimental?

Simply put the very best in the city.   Or anywhere else in Philly has been making steak since the seventies he knows how to make him write he's learned from the best. When you get a cheesesteak from are you open up in the steam hit your mouth you get taste how delicious it is if you don't go to Barry's you don't know what you're talk about when it comes to cheesesteaks

I have LOVED MTJ for years. Unfortunately, this visit to the St. Charles location was not as stellar. First, the wait time you see on Yelp is not accurate if you use the no wait feature. The wait was 45 min longer when we arrived. No big deal, we grabbed a spot at the packed bar and were all set. The bartenders were quick even with the busy bar. The margs were a bit meh but not bad. Also, after years of visiting their many locations this is the first time we tried the chips and salsa, very underwhelming. 

The one thing that ruined the meal for me was a hair in my salad. Completely lost my appetite. I took one bite of the salad when i saw the hair and that was it. I am not sure how long the PTSD will linger from this follicle to return but tonight was no bueno.

I really wanted to like this place.  I went for breakfast and was squeezed in right by the hostess stand.  No big deal.
Ordered the crawfish and crab Benedict and coffee.  First thing that happened was the milk curdled in my coffee.  Then I got my breakfast and I'm not sure how - but the inside of my poached eggs were cold.  Not lukewarm - cold.  Disappointing :(
The rest of the breakfast was good though...

Horrible, unfriendly service. The past three visits no toy in the Happy Meal. If your out of toys let us know or throw in a dessert. They need to walk across the street to a Chick Fila and take notes on customer service 101.

Cozy patisserie in Santa Barbara, big outdoor seating area with great music.

We ordered the BLT+E and it's an open faced BLT, the thick slab of pork belly bacon was amazing and perfectly cooked. This was an awesome breakfast. I will comeback for this.

I also ordered the Apple Tart and OMG that was soooo good! 

I love the ambiance and service was great.

I never got to even eat the food. I made a reservation for 8 pm for 2 people. I arrived at my reserved time only to see many people waiting and a long list. I was informed I would have to wait but the hostess couldn't even tell me how long it would be. What is the point of reservations if you cannot honor them? I certainly will not be back.
Dylan was awesome ! Would come back again. Great food and atmosphere. Bartenders and service are excellent as well!

Great, prompt service.  Ordered a veggie burger to go.  Can go wrong with a veggie burger.

Pretty steady customer base at 4 pm in the afternoon on a Saturday.  Ordered the burger, ran out to get some movie gift cards as Christmas presents (shhh, don't tell) and came back to pick up the burger.

Great service, flavorful food, lots of options.  South Reno location, yay!
We have never had a bad experience with Blarney. Their food and service is on point. Delivery is quick and accurate.

Because the restaurant has recently moved to this new location (June), it seems they are still tweaking things. Upon my arrival at 5:50p, they hadn't yet unlocked the door; and parts of the restaurant seemed like they were still moving in. Aside from those little bits, the service was great and the food fantastic. Because they moved into the prior establishment, there are TVs up and the Bollywood music videos were playing. It was just what my soul needed this evening...delicious Indian cuisine and relaxing atmosphere. When visiting Indy, this will be one of my go-to locations.
Best sushi spot in Florida! I live in Miami and this is by far better than any sushi restaurant there. Highly recommend.

Portions are large...
Benedict's is very welcoming and the service is fast and friendly. Ask your server for suggestions , they did not disappoint when I asked. I had the bacon and sausage skillet and my wife had the bacon and spinach Benedict which we give both a 10/10. This is definitely a spot you have to visit if in or near Dunedin.

On Saturday, December 28th 2019, my boyfriend and I wanted to spend our date at this specific Buffalo Wild Wings. We got there and we got seated in about five minutes. But when it came time to order, no waiter or waitress was willing to take our order. There was a family of four sitting diagonal from where we were seated and got their order taken within a 30 minute span after seating. 45 minutes pass, and we still haven't gotten our order taken. A couple walks in and gets seated and after five seconds their order got taken! We have been in our seats for almost an hour without service! So we left. We felt ignored, angry, and disgusted about this service we have received.

I come here all the time. The food is fantastic and the service is even better.  They always have a smile on their faces even when its packed and crazy.  If you want a great salad, this is the place to go!

I am so late writing this review, but I had to say something about this delicious food. Luckily I was able to dine inside this restaurant before the shutdown happen. My friend and I came here on a Sunday. My coworkers told me about this place months ago and I just never made time to go. When I arrived for lunch the place wasn't crowded. The host seated us right away. The decor inside is so amazing! They have the most unique table booths and lights hanging from the ceiling. The tables are not super close together which I loved as well. The waitress gave us menus and told us about the appetizers and margaritas. We decided on chips and salsa. I ordered the carne asada tacos and a margarita. I can't remember the exact name of the margarita, but it had grapefruit juice in it. Such a refreshing drink! My friend got the chicken quesadillas. She said the flavoring was so amazing she could taste a hint of lemon and it was perfect. The sauce on the side was a bit too spicy for her so she gave it to me. I love spicy and I was happy to take it off her hands! My steak tacos were good ! I just wish they were bigger. I could've went for three more because they were so tiny lol. I plan to come back here one day and I want to try the Mexican street corn and churros.

La Segunda lives up to it's reputation. The cafe con leche is a must have - hot, creamy and oh so good. The flips are my favorite item in the entire bakery. The guava and cheese flip is a delicious piece of joy. I also had a veggie sandwich - lettuce, tomato, avocado, slight onions and slight bell peppers on toasted Cuban bread. I highly recommend La Segunda Bakery.

Is it possible to offer 0 stars? Ordered online only to find out after walking there that they were closed. Knock on the door, make eye contact with someone, and they walk out of the back door.  He made sure to yell at me from down the street that I should contact the company I ordered thru for my refund because "it wasn't their problem."  How's that for customer service?

Nice restaurant with great outdoor dining - the outdoor seating overlooks a golf course. The service was good overall - the server was pleasant and attentive; my girls and I all ordered the Whiskey Burger but subbed the burger with a Beyond Meat patty. The sandwich was satisfying but didn't have much flavor. We also ordered desserts, which we just OK - I ordered The Fat Elvis. In the end, the pricing was reasonable... If you are looking for a dining experience with a chill ambiance, check this place out. Also, it's located just outside of the city with its own parking lot... Will definitely return.

Enjoyed a lively Friday evening in the Funk Zone after my daughter had her senior portraits taken in town- parked in the new structure and walked to Tyger Tyger with ease, every place we passed was packed and humming!  We waited in line at Tyger Tyger, ordered and patiently waited- soon enough our Lotus Roll, Tofu Bahn Mi and Crispy Rice Salad arrived - very fresh, solid heat in all the sauces on the table and really just tasty food all around.  I thought the prices were fair- the $11 Grenache rose was splendid!  Next time hope to come down from the SYV on a week night to see the place in a less busy zone.
Such an amazing spot! The food was great and our server Marcos was awesome. Definitely would come back again
One of our favorite eating places in downtown Pottstown.  Fantastic hand carved  turkey sandwiches and homemade delicious soups served daily.

Stopped by Landmark last night and overall it was a great time catching up with my friends who I barely get to go out with. We all ordered a drink or two, I had the lemon drop martini which was pretty good and I also got a mango mojito with grey goose instead of Bacardi and that was fire! For my meal I had the jerk salmon caesar salad which was more well done than I would have liked it to be but whatever I still ate it; however my friends all enjoyed their meals. My only complaint would be that the host placed us on an hour wait just for us to get seated and be rushed when ordering our food. The kitchen stopped accepting orders which I felt was a bit rude considering they closed at 12AM and stopped accepting food orders at 10:45PM. I personally felt that the server was trying to hurry up and get off work maybe, but regardless my night would've been more enjoyable if it wasn't rushed. Next time I will just come earlier but this place used to be known for its late night dining, doesn't seem like the place for that anymore.

Walked into this place while waiting for rest of my party to land at airport. Easily walkable from Omni hotel. Seated immediately and offered to have the stroller I had with me put away. Immediately was greeted and brought water. I had great service and the most delish drink I have ever had! Food was recommended to me as Mac and cheese. It was SO good! I highly recommend this place. Delicious food, drinks, and the entire staff was friendly and accommodating.

Love this place!! Cozy vibe. Lots of plaid, comfy recliners to sit it by with fireside pits outdoors. Amazing drinks and the whiskey cake and other desserts are so good!! I got the guava cocktail that was amazing!  Also love all their appetizers.  The Mac and cheese and the fried green tomatoes! Whiskey cake comes with a bowl full of whipped cream that is delicious and so fresh tasting! Loved it. 

Also been here for brunch. It's got amazing juices. Definitely coming back to try more of the fresh pressed juices. Got the pink drink it was sooo good!! 

Also they made a small error for my friends meal and gave it to her for free because we were in a hurry to get to the airport also gave us fruit cup to go to have at the airport. So thoughtful and amazing service!! This place truly is top notch!! A great addition to Tampa eateries.

I had the Kakoa beef.  The beef itself was good. I opted for steamed veggies.  The rice was soaking in a teriyaki sauce, it was soupy.  The veggies were overcooked and soggy.  I could have made a better dish at home. Sorry Hawaiian Time, it's not personal, but you need to up your game. And don't use so much plastic. In fact your dish should be able to go in a paper product, that is, if it isn't soggy.

What I loved most about this place was their willingness to feed us despite being late due to traffic out from NYC on a Friday evening. Food was really special and the atmosphere cozy and welcoming. Chef also came by to talk with us and maybe gauge our food interests. It took us awhile to find the damn place, being down an alley off the main street. But definitely worth finding. And we're so grateful they had patience with us calling a few times to say we were later and then later coming in. Also, I'm posting this about three months late, having dropped in mid-November 2019, that's how good this place was, what a great memory for us, and how much we appreciated their hospitality. Definitely we'll come back next time we're in this part of the world.

My go to for sushi! I always get my 3 rollls special with salmon avocado and a free miso soup. It Nevers disappoint. I always order for takeout there and the person on the phone is so nice and polite, I love a great customer service.

Excellent Indian cuisine.  The first time I went - I was sorely disappointed - I had the lunch buffet and it was nothing special(Disclaimer:  I don't like buffets in general anywhere).  I reluctantly went a few months later in the evening for food off the menu.  HUGE difference.  They have the best butter chicken in town - great depth of flavor.  I'm a Dosa fanatic and I highly recommend the Amaravati special Dosa with chicken curry- just really really good.  The Korma (chicken or veg) is outstanding.  All the naan is legit!  

If you like Indian food.... go!

Twice in the past two weeks they got the idea wrong
We ordered Shoyou chicken and twice they gave us pulled pork
We understand the current circumstances but if they can't  do the menu they need to tell the customers not push something else out the door
Twice!  Sheesh!
The food is ok, but the service is pretty shabby and for the price they should do a better job

Came back to introduce my boyfriend to hotpot as another hotpot place i wanted to try was an even further drive, and I'm glad I did! 

This time i tried the Mala Soup base, SOO much better and actually had flavor other than spice, and even spicier! 

Ambient temperature was much better and comfortable as well compared to my first visit.

And boyfriend is a big fan so I'm sure we'll be back!

Walk up and step back to yesterday...

Fats Domino was playing under the umbrella as we approached. The sweet creamery smell wafted through the air.

The menu board can be pleasantly overwhelming, with so many excellent options and some popular suggested combinations.

The base is either vanilla or chocolate custard. It's creamy, rich and utterly decadent.

I went with a build my own - vanilla base, hot fudge, marshmallow and cashew. The whole cashews throughout were an amazing touch. The salty, sweet combo was divine, service was amazing and the prices were quite reasonable.

If you're in the area, swing back and live a few minutes in the past. You won't regret it. Low fat and low sugar options also available.

Even the bathroom is like being in the cooler. I know, I know... weird, but true. It was cold and smelled just like a creamery!

Yum! 

What a cute little find. 

Highly recommend the sweet potato biscuits with butter and berry berry jam :) 

Delicious coffee and friendly staff! 

Also a great spot for gelato. Enjoy!
This restaurant is an absolute amazing restaurant, if you go definitely request Maranda, Steph or Bri they are the best servers, amazing services!!!!

Very disappointed! Couldn't wait to try after getting a gift card. Waited forever to be seated after told 20 mins it more like 50 mins. Food was editable. Wings were ok. Brisket was fatty, burritos were missing ingredients that were listed in menu. Missing part of our order that we had to wait a while to get. Servers were not very friendly or attentive. We even had to send back the glasses of water because they tasted terrible.  We then requested soda that was flat!!  Would never go back or recommend.

Second visit.  Their new location is much bigger than there old one.  Food was just as good.  I had the Popover Sampler and had a hard time deciding which was my favorite.  Topped it off with powdered sugar popover.  Waitstaff was busy but they made a point of refilling out ice tea.  Will definitely be bac

I was very disappointed in our lasagna bundle this past Monday
from Carrabba's on Dalemabry in Carrollwood.
My husband picked it up and when he returned home they call him and said they forgot to put the salad in the bag. He asked me if he should go back. I said yes because all we had was lasagna and bread. He returned with the salad and I dished out the meal. I was very surprised to see there was no ricotta in the lasagna. We had mozzarella which was hard but no ricotta. I can understand in these times things are difficult and they might have been out of it but I would think if they didn't have the ingredients they should have told us and we would have ordered something else. The noodles and sauce were just fine but I could have ordered spaghetti and not the lasagna.

They do have a mask mandate and limited capacity and social distancing in the dining area and signs are posted on the entertainment floor. Unfortunately those rules are not enforced. Patrons seemed to wander from game to game as they pleased standing closely together. I didn't witness anything being cleaned during out 2 hours there. However I did see several large bottles of hand sanitizer on the floor I assume it was placed there for public use because there was no signage to indicate one way or another
My husband doesn't like to complain. So whoever serve this to him. Would you eat this???

When I want to treat my wife and kids to a bowl of ice cream we go to the small batch, fresh made, inventive, local ice cream shop. Unfortunately, that ice cream is a bit expensive. So, if my wife and I aren't eating and I want a quick, less expensive way to celebrate (read bribe), Dairy Queen Grill and Chill is our go to place.

While Dairy Queen has a whole menu of specialty ice creams with a slew of interesting mix ins which they dub Blizzards, my kids go for the tried and true chocolate ice cream with sprinkles. I've encouraged them to branch out to no avail. The ice cream here is consistent. It always looks the same and, from what I can gather, tastes the same too. 

You want gourmet, homemade, small batch ice cream...this is not your place. You want an inexpensive way to bribe your ice cream obsessed kids? Do it!

Our Yelp First Friday first pick. Spicy Tonkutsu -sinus clearing with a good warmth on the lips. Delish. Karaage chicken - fried chicken strips with a tasty sauce and scallions .  Gyoza - yummy! And fried shumai (dunked in the dumpling sauce). Fantastic. We ordered it to go, but there was enough space to social distance so we ate in. Nice place. Will be our place for ramen as the price was reasonable, too.

We've been waiting for a while to finally get to try Que Rica's.  Absolutely every item we ordered was amazing.  The food arrived hot, the dishes were beautifully prepared and presented and
The flavors were out of this world.  The arepas, empanadas, loaded yuca fries and tojadas were all top notch.  I can no wait to try more things from the menu.

Since my last review, which was not kind, I have been back several times. All of our experiences were excellent. Service was great and so was the unique and tasty food. Teddy's has a great feel and ambiance. We will go back their often. (My first review should have taken into account the pressures of COVID times. I appreciate that Jennifer J. pointed this out to me.)

Enjoyed an awesome lunch here! I really like the atmosphere and decor. The inside is great, and they have a small outdoor seating area too. We got a smoked sausage flatbread, and it was okay. Pretty good, not awesome. Then we got pulled pork with fries and Mac n cheese. The Mac n cheese was not great, but the fries were amazing. They were cut using skin-on potatoes which I love, and they were fried and seasoned perfectly. Decently salty but not overwhelming and perfectly crispy. So good. And the pulled pork was amazing too. I'm not positive that they put beer in their pulled pork, but I could taste it, so I'm pretty sure it's there! Pulled pork was really delicious, and I liked the 4 bbq sauces they give you with it. Each one is so different - a white sauce, a thin spicy sauce, and mustard sauce, and a more gradient so sweet sauce. Those were all really good. We would go again, but we would stick with the bbq and fries and spring for some beers next time instead of a flatbread.

Simple cafe with excellent food. It's gotta be tough selling Vietnamese food in this West Nashville neighborhood with 5 similar places close by, but this place never disappoints. Very simple menu with 5 choices, and fresh Vietnamese pastries on the counter. Highly recommended for a fast fresh lunch.

I really like this place overall. The atmosphere is great, higher end sports bar. Plenty of TVs up around entirety of restaurant for various games. Also outdoor tent for around 40 degree weather and above. On colts game day, they had televisions in tent as well. The beer selection is pretty good, not great. Usually about 7-8 IPAs available. Wish they did 5 oz pours or half pours to create flights. Food is good. The pretzel is exceptional-served with white queso and beer cheese. Mac n cheese also stellar. Nothing else is "exceptional" but all is quite good. Have yet to have anything that I have not liked. Safe bet with anything on menu including burgers, pizza, chicken tenders, fries, soups, hummus. Good service. Open at lunch. Torn between 4 and 5 star here but feel like for "non-game day" typical lunch/dinner/drink outing more on the 4 star end while 5 star game experience. Highly recommend and is a staple now downtown!

Very sloppy and poor customer service. The gentleman wearing a mask and gloves, took our money, dealt with the cash register and the window, gave us change back, and then went and put our order together. Touching our food with the same gloved hands that he just touched everything thing else with. Turns out....they made our order wrong. It's just a bad impression after already having poor customer service. Won't be back....

Worst customer service ever!! Flat out lying!! 

So, we came in a while ago , waited for good 30-40mins. 
They wrote on their book 5 -2 adults 3 kids. 

3 people came in waited for 5 mins gets to sit.
I was in hurry to ask how come they get to sit first when we were told we're next. Answer .. "they reserved since morning" uhhhhmmm yah right lying !!! And then they said oh we only accept to go orders. Yah right after you seat 3 people who took our spot!!!! And we been waiting for 30mins and you're telling us now?!!!! And how rude you yell "ok ok ok we make the table now"

LOVE the Parkshore Grill. Stumbled along this amazing place during a lunch break when I was traveling for work. I always sit at the bar & ask the bartender for suggestions. I picked 2 starters the crab cake & lobster toast. They were both amazing but I plan on going back tomorrow during my lunch to get the lobster toast one more time! Honestly I'll probably get both again but the toast was my favorite.

So obviously when you're in Nashville Hattie B's is a must to go to. So we came here waited in line for about 20 minutes or so and man was it worth it. Got the small white meat combo with Mac and cheese and baked beans. Added a whole wing and potato salad and got a beer to wash it all down. Now I'm someone who can tolerate insanely spicy food so I had to get the "shut the cluck up" flavor. MAN was this hot lol. But it burned so good lol, the chicken was super crispy and super juicy. The sides were amazing and I added an extra side of the shut the cluck up sauce. Granted it wasn't the smartest decision but it sure was delicious. If you can tolerate spice I suggest you try it. Absolutely amazing food.

Flavorful. Crispy. Even good the next day if you don't finish. I came here to get pick up but I almost wish we ate in. They had a full bar and it just looked like a great place to chill and eat. I have been dying to try Korean fried chicken and man they totally did not disappoint. That food was amazing. It was hot, flavorful, spicy, and the sauce options were just superb. I only regret not buying one of their Korean drinks because I was thinking about it. I am impressed and will be back. Maybe as a date.

This Taco Bus is permanently parked at a Shell station, but don't let the location fool you. This place is so good. And lots of great vegan options too! I am currently enjoying a butter nut squash taco and a vegan "steak" strip burrito. And being in a gas station, it is handy to grab a beer from the walk-in beer cave to go with your meal. There are several table outside to enjoy your fine gas station cuisine. Cheers!

We have visited Hofbräuhaus twice now, with drastically different experiences. Our first visit was several months ago when we thoroughly enjoyed the atmosphere of their German style bierhall and food. 
We went again last night with out of town guests and were extremely disappointed. We had called ahead for our party of 5, and were seated quickly. Our initial drink order (no alcohol) came quickly, but then things deteriorated from there. Our waiter didn't return for nearly 20 minutes to check on us when we said we were ready to order, and then runners kept bringing various orders and asking if they were for us on at least five occasions. Our food finally arrived probably around 40 minutes later, and was missing one entree entirely. The final entree didn't arrive until the rest of us had already finished about an additional 20 minutes later and was delivered by a manager -- but not a word of apology or anything was expressed. A beer ordered when the entrees arrived only arrived with the check. Overall we were greatly disappointed and while we might attempt one more visit on our own, we won't be bringing guests again, as while the food is decent, the overall experience of service was so poor.

I have visited Kalaya on two occasions. The first time was at  a members-only dinner club event at Kalaya where we sampled a pre-set menu of some of the menu highlights. At that event we sampled the sakoo sai hed (the tapioca dumplings with shitake mushrooms) the chicken curry,  the mushroom  and tofu curry, an eggplant dish and finally a sticky rice and mango dessert. The entire evening was a delight but it may not be the most helpful to review as it was a pre-planned event for a members only club so it may not be a fair depiction of a normal night out. But we loved the food and had to go back so we went back on another night. 

We made the reservation a week or so in advance (if you want a reservation for a weekend or Friday night, I suggest you book at least a week or so in advance). We booked a table around 8 pm on a Thursday. We arrived about 15 minutes early and were able to be seated within a five minutes.  The hostess was very nice and worked quickly to accommodate us. I will say the area you wait is a little inconvenient, but this is a small BYO so it's not something that was all to surprising and what you'd expect at most BYO's. 

Once seated we ordered the chicken wing appetizer and our bottle of wine was promptly opened for us. The chicken wings were only okay to be honest, although I don't know why we ordered chicken wings at a Thai restaurant. The rest of dinner, however, was truly spectacular (much like our first experience at Kalaya). 

We ordered the mushroom

Everything was delicious and made well. However I paid $8 for literally 5 popcorn shrimp. That's not even enough to share as an "appetizer." So I won't be getting their "appetizers" in future orders but I would still get the sushi again. Also they give you a tiny little bit of wasabi and pickles ginger. I ordered like 6 rolls and I get enough wasabi for one roll, very disappointed, especially when I asked them on the phone (for my second order from them) to give me some extra this time.

Hinge has been my go-to brunch spot in Philly for years!! It's a really cute and cozy cafe. The food and ambiance are both a definite 5/5. At times, however, the service could be better. 

Their breakfast skillet is probably my favorite thing on the breakfast menu, although their French toast is also really great. When they have the pumpkin French toast with pecan butter on the menu, i usually get an order of that because it's just perfect. 

On the lunch menu, they have chicken parm soup, which may sound weird, but I promise you, it's amazing.  

Their hot chocolate and chai tea latte are also pretty fantastic. 

Late weekend mornings can get kind of busy, so you may wait to be seated, but I've never had to wait more than 15 min or so. Parking around there can also be a challenge since they don't have a designated parking area. 

If you're looking for a great (& reasonably priced) brunch spot, try Hinge for sure!
